title: Infinity Portal with White Rat
description: A white rat stands on its hind legs in the foreground holding a small infinity symbol, gazing toward a large ornate stone archway covered in ivy. Inside the arch is a vibrant swirling rainbow portal containing two dragons (green and red) forming an infinity loop, a small purple-clad figure, stars, and flowers, set against a cosmic night sky with shooting stars and nebulae.
prompt: A white rat standing upright on hind legs in the foreground holds a small glowing infinity symbol while looking at an ornate stone archway covered in ivy and flowers. Through the arch is a swirling rainbow portal containing a green dragon and a red dragon intertwined into an infinity figure, a small purple figure in a red cloak, stars, and flowers. The background is a dark cosmic sky with shooting stars, nebulae, and clouds. Yellow flowers, ferns, and colorful mushrooms grow at the base, intricate fantasy illustration style.
